en.role: Minister of Economic Development and Trade
en.quote: We believe we have a good chance of completing the process of joining the WTO by the end of this year.
en.head: Russia did not join the WTO until 2012.
en.body: Russia became a World Trade Organization member on August 22, 2012. Gref had called the chances of completing accession by the end of 2006 “good,” without guaranteeing it; the timing forecast proved wrong.
